profileFacts.description:
Pure Bakes is Hyderabad’s luxury custom cake studio, handcrafting fully bespoke cakes for weddings, birthdays, engagements, baby showers and every celebration.

Every cake — including multi-tier wedding designs — is available in both egg and 100% eggless with no compromise on taste, texture or height, a favourite among Hyderabad’s Jain and vegetarian families.

We’re FSSAI certified and bake fresh to order using best chocolate and high quality fruit purées.

Beyond cakes, we run Hyderabad’s leading Telugu-language baking classes, online and offline.

Message us on WhatsApp for a free design consultation — we reply within 2 hours, 7 days a week, with safe AC-cab delivery across Hyderabad.
